criteria: Accepted all LUX-138 criteria at the submitted source commit: Preview menu frame and Record/Stop actions with visible fixed-dimension status; output-only capture at the designated backing dimensions independent of the smaller panel; finite-duration playable and seekable WebM; safe stop, cancellation, runtime replacement, concurrent finalization, and app-close cleanup; actual-app still/video demonstration; independent source, UI, and integration review.
evidence: Independent reviewer inspected commit 0f6a6b7758226bbf18bd48498a09e4875d452d30 and the IPC/file/recorder lifecycle. Fresh focused tests passed 16/16: node --test tests/studio/preview-capture-files.test.ts tests/studio/preview-recorder.test.ts tests/studio/webm-duration.test.ts. Studio and root TypeScript checks exited 0. Full Studio CPU produced the known unrelated control-description timing flake at 194/195; the exact isolated rerun passed 1/1. Native result artifacts/studio-capture/result.json records a 455x288 displayed preview saved as decoded 1920x1080 PNG, a 650332-byte 1920x1080 WebM with finite 2.912 s duration, playback advance and successful seek 1.7472 to 1.747547, plus close-during-recording removal of destination and temporary files. recording.png and workspace.png show clear recording status, dimensions, Stop action, and narrow-layout hierarchy; keyboard operation inherits the independently tested StudioMenu behavior. Source was clean-merged into main at e2f2618f4c459a37083160ba66a8181bdd6cfd07 (parents 498f7039 and submitted 0f6a6b77). Root integration evidence artifacts/feedback-01a0a7bb/capture-integration.log passes 23 combined capture, recorder, WebM, renderer, and animation checks; combined Studio/root types pass and diff-check is clean. Fresh node scripts/install-visual-skill.mjs --check reports current true with empty missing, changed, and unexpected lists. Installed desktop package replacement and final all-feature package QA are outside LUX-138's stated acceptance and remain explicitly pending.
